title: Crafting the Future of Fine Fragrance
subtitle: Born in Grasse, France — Étoile bridges ancestral French perfumery with cutting-edge glass packaging engineering.
storyTitle: The French Legacy of Olfactory Artisanship
storyP1: Founded in Grasse, the perfume capital of the world, Étoile was established to supply luxury perfume houses with unrivaled glass components and authentic French fragrance oils.
storyP2: We combine centuries of French perfumery expertise with modern industrial precision, producing heavy-weight glass bottles, magnetic closures, and IFRA-certified extracts.
val1Desc: Every batch of perfume concentrate undergoes GC-MS testing in our Grasse laboratories.
val2Desc: Recyclable heavy glass, eco-lacquers, and refillable pump mechanisms.
val3Desc: Assisting indie brands from initial liquid formulation to final shelf-ready packaged products.
